text:
Sara M.: Quick sync — finalizing the post-webinar recording + lead routing playbook for Wednesday's 'Inference at Scale' session. Can we lock down Zoom settings, where recordings land, and how replay access maps to HubSpot?

Tom G.: +1. Quick checklist from ops side: enable cloud recording, auto-transcription, set host alternative in case someone jumps in, and make sure the recording is *not* set to auto-delete. Also recommend local backup on the presenter's laptop.

Sara M.: Agreed. Zoom settings I was planning to use:
```
Account > Recordings > Cloud Recording: enable
  - Record active speaker with shared screen
  - Record gallery view (for clips)
  - Audio only as backup
  - Automatic transcription: ON (generate VTT)
Account > Meeting > Alternative host: add @harish
Meeting scheduling > Enable 'Record the meeting automatically' (host)
```
Can someone confirm we can turn on 'recording consent' checkbox for registrants?

zoom-bot: Recording will be started automatically per meeting settings. Cloud transcript will appear under the host's recordings within ~10-20 min after end.

Harish P.: Yes to consent checkbox. For downstream, plan: 1) download cloud MP4+VTT once available, 2) run quick trim + clip creation (30s hero clip, 60s feature clips, 2-3 topic clips), 3) upload master + clips to Wistia (or Vimeo) for gating + analytics.

Leah K.: For lead routing: registration is HubSpot form (embedded on our landing page). Important: preserve UTM params and add hidden fields: webinar_id=ias_2026_03_25, session_ts=1778887777. Use a Zap/HubSpot workflow to tag new contacts with property: "webinar_registered: inference_at_scale".

Harish P.: For gating replay: prefer Wistia because it lets us require an email for the replay and returns a view event we can map to HubSpot via Segment. If someone is already a contact, we just append webinar_viewed_{pct} events. Proposed event names: webinar_view_start, webinar_view_25, webinar_view_50, webinar_view_75, webinar_view_100.

Tom G.: Automation notes:
- If contact = new, HubSpot form creates contact + lifecycle stage = lead.
- If replay view >= 50% OR download slides, update lifecycle -> MQL.
- Workflow name convention: "Webinar: Inference at Scale - Replay Engagement v1"
- Add property updates: webinar_engagement = replay_watched_75 (string)

Leah K.: How do we capture clip downloads vs full replay? I want separate scoring.

Harish P.: Add two properties: webinar_content_downloaded (boolean list) and webinar_replay_pct (numeric). Workflow logic: if webinar_replay_pct >= 50 set score +20; if webinar_content_downloaded set score +10. Then run nightly sync to SFDC; lead owner assignment by territory rules already in place.

Sara M.: Post-event cadence I'm proposing (timers relative to meeting end):
- 30 minutes: immediate replay email (subject: "Thanks — here's the replay: Inference at Scale") with primary CTA: schedule demo + secondary CTA: watch 2-min highlight clip (ungated).
- 48 hours: clip-focused email with customer quote + link to gated full replay.
- 7 days: invite to 1:1 demo (conditional on MQL).
- 14 days: final nudge + short survey link.

Tom G.: I'll draft the 30-min email copy. Also suggest we publish the hero clip publicly on Twitter + LinkedIn (un-gated) and include UTM tags so we can attribute signups back to the clip. Example UTM string: ?utm_source=social&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=ias_replay_clip

Leah K.: For HubSpot workflow, I'll create triggers: form submission -> add contact to list "IAS - Registered" -> send confirmation email -> schedule replay-job. Need someone to confirm which video host (Wistia vs Vimeo) we finalize so I can wire webhook events.

Harish P.: I'm happy to produce the clips. Plan: export MP4 from Zoom master, use ffmpeg script to create versions and burn in VTT captions for social shorts. Quick ffmpeg sample I'll use: 
```
# hero clip extraction (first 2 minutes)
ffmpeg -i master.mp4 -ss 00:00:00 -to 00:02:00 -c copy hero.mp4
# short clip (30s) crop and transcode for IG/TT
ffmpeg -i master.mp4 -ss 00:08:15 -to 00:08:45 -vf "scale=720:-2" -c:v libx264 -crf 23 short30.mp4
```
I'll hand off files to content ops with captions and suggested CTAs.

Sara M.: Ownership recap: Harish -> clips + caption files. Leah -> HubSpot forms & workflows + mapping to Marketo/SEGMENT/Zapier as needed. Tom -> social distribution and autoresponder copy. Sara -> Zoom setup + meeting host instructions + replay email template.

Tom G.: One last ask — can we add a hidden field on the registration form 'content_preference' (demo | pricing | architecture) so PMM can tailor follow-ups?

Leah K.: Good call. Will add hidden content_preference (default: demo).

Sara M.: Great — I'll schedule a 20-min dry run tomorrow at 10:30am to test recording + transcription + download pipeline. Ping me if you can't make it. :white_check_mark:

zoom-bot: Reminder set for dry run (2026-03-24 10:30).
